cd D:\npqo
@'
node_modules/
dist/
dev-server.log
*.log
.DS_Store
'@ | Set-Content -Encoding ascii .gitignore
$listener = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5180 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($listener) { Stop-Process -Id $listener.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Remove-Item dev-server.log -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Get-ChildItem screenshots | Select-Object Name,Length
$report = Get-Content screenshots\verification.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$report.viewports | Format-Table viewport,columns,room,cards,candleBodies,scrollWidth,clientWidth,screenshotBytes
$report.interactions | Select-Object beforeHold,heldTick,heldTickAfterWait,steppedTick,resumedTick,tooltip,mode
Get-ChildItem src,scripts | Select-Object Name,Length
